description: Agent management operations (create, list, queue_task, task_status)
template: Agent lifecycle and task management operations

parameters.name: specialized_files
parameters.description: List of files this agent manages (required for create operation)

parameters.name: agent_id
parameters.description: Agent ID (required for queue_task, task_status, task_result, self_queue operations)

parameters.name: task_id
parameters.description: Task ID (required for task_status and task_result operations)

parameters.name: message
parameters.description: Task message/request (required for queue_task and self_queue operations)

parameters.name: task_type
parameters.description: Task type: code_generation, file_edit, conversation (optional for queue_task, defaults to code_generation)

parameters.name: iteration_type
parameters.description: Iteration type for tool filtering: add_class, add_method, add_function, add_validation, finalize, fix_errors (optional for self_queue)

parameters.name: context_hint
parameters.description: Additional context for the task (optional for self_queue)

parameters.name: parent_task_id
parameters.description: Parent task ID for tracking (internal use for self_queue)

parameters.name: recursion_depth
parameters.description: Current recursion depth (internal use for self_queue)
